item.title: The Evolution of Songs About Fear: An Experience Through Embeddings
item.description: Forty years of songs that talk about fear, read blind and measured with embeddings: the threat moved from the street into one's own mind, fear shifted to first-person confession, and songs learned to work through it.

item.title: What Should an Agent Remember? Album Narratives with LangGraph and MLflow
item.description: An empirical study of bounded memory, distant lyrical evidence, and token use across four albums.
